---
applyTo: "instagram/**"
---
When working anywhere under `instagram/`, treat `instagram/lessons.md` as
authoritative guidance. Read it before drafting or reviewing posts.

Folder conventions:
- `instagram/posts/`     — drafted posts, one file per date (`YYYY-MM-DD.md`).
- `instagram/metrics/`   — raw analytics, one file per post (`YYYY-MM-DD.json`).
- `instagram/lessons.md` — append-only log of insights. Never rewrite history.
